Name: Make Gil Nyapu
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A Nyapu style portrait replacing Gil from WerewolfMaster's Make Gil Real.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Things I Might Add:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Seasonal outfits (just recolors of his current outfit)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A less goofy surprised portrait. I love the goofy Nyapu one and as best I can tell, the surprised portrait isn't even used in the dialogue & events added by Make Gil Real, so for now I just kept it as is.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Extract it from the .zip and put it in your mods folder.
If you have other mods that replace Gil's portrait (For example, AhCuteArt's Seasonal Nyapu Portraits) you should turn off Gil in those mods.[/color]
